scope: same 100-stock published qfq archived observations, 2023-2025, research_only
fixed_filter: original baseline and original return_volatility(20)<0.03; no new formula/threshold
sample: baseline==1; candidate 1 selected, 0 rejected, null UNKNOWN; first schedule, then finite saved forward AND MAE, then dates with both groups
schedule: first baseline signal per security per stage, next strictly after prior saved label_end_5; candidate UNKNOWN or missing future outcome still consumes original window
primary_metric: date_equal_pairs.mae.difference (selected minus disjoint rejected; positive less adverse)
weights: paired means equal dates / equal securities within date; worst ceil(5%*n) tails event-weighted on exactly those complete matched events
limitations: Post-exploration sensitivity on known results, not blind validation.
No p-value, causal attribution, independent Alpha, trade/cost/PIT or account risk claim.
Three years and both panels all retained; no return-dependent replacements.
